units: mm (z = span, root face at z = 218.0)
status: Current CAD baseline for the stated scope. Documented geometry review only; not validated by CFD, CHT, FEA, experiment or manufacturing qualification.

baseline.data_section_note: SHA-256 of the STEP bytes from the newline before the line 'DATA;' to the end of the file. It is identical to the file on which the geometry review was carried out (full-file SHA-256 below); only the header lines differ.

structural_derivative.description: Outer body and passage network only: holes, ribs, pins and the trailing-edge cut-back removed. Intended as a meshing-friendly starting point for a structural model.

parent.note: Same cooling architecture; rib surfaces were faceted (3,846 faces in total). Not published here; the hash identifies the file whose face counts are compared with the current design.
